digest.component_or_area: LLM provider framework (runner.py, anthropic_model.py, structured.py, providers.py)
propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is Anthropic-shaped in practice despite being provider-agnostic in principle, with hardcoded provider-name matching at multiple call sites (runner.py:268, runner.py:316, structured.py:46) and a refusal to accept base_url/api_key configuration

AWS Bedrock is a primary client access path to Claude but rebar has no native Bedrock support, forcing users through OpenAI-compatible gateways that lose prompt caching, retrying transport, read timeouts, and native structured output
the signed verdict sidecar records only a model string that no longer names the actual provider, making it impossible for consumers to distinguish first-class verdicts from best-effort ones
configuration keys REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY are documented as working but are refused at runtime by _pai_check_config, making the documentation false

the retry and timeout configuration (llm_retry_max_attempts, llm_retry_max_wait_s, timeout_s) is implemented only for the direct-Anthropic path via tenacity and httpx, and does not reach the production Bedrock path at all
